title: Rethinking Africa’s green mineral future
body:
The evidence is clear: China has emerged as Africa’s mineral processing hub.

Two figures in our report (https://lnkd.in/eJUPe8hF) are particularly striking and underscore the scale and depth of this transformation.

- China’s consolidation as Africa’s mineral processing hub is not merely a trade outcome but a structural feature of the global green and digital economy.
- Left unaddressed, this pattern risks locking African economies into a role as suppliers of unprocessed ores while value addition, technological learning, and industrial rents accrue elsewhere.

The policy imperative is therefore not to decouple from China, but to recalibrate partnerships, incentives, and industrial policies to ensure that mineral extraction translates into domestic processing capacity, industrial capabilities, and long-term structural transformation within Africa.
